We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons count. Use carbon NMR to see aromatic region (around 120-150 ppm). Could also use HSQC to correlate. Simpler: get carbon NMR and count peaks in aromatic region.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
